title: Chinese Immersion Library resource
description: One Chinese-language resource (website, channel, podcast or app). scripts/build.py enforces the same rules without dependencies.

id.description: Stable unique id. Never change it once published; clients may store it.

url.description: Where the user should be taken.

level.description: Who can follow it. Native content is usually ["advanced"] or ["intermediate","advanced"].

for_learners.description: true when made specifically for learners of Chinese.

language.description: Language the content is presented in.

login.description: none = everything opens without an account; partial = much is open, but some content, full quality or continued browsing asks you to sign in, install an app or pay; required = must sign in to see the content.

subtitles.description: Chinese subtitles (closed captions) or transcripts available as text, free or paid. Burned-in subtitles don't count. Omitted when there are none or it's unknown.

recommended.description: A pick: well-known, free, active, and opens without an account (login must be none).

format.description: youtube = YouTube channel Atom feed; podcast = podcast RSS; rsshub = an RSSHub route (self-host for production).

notes.description: Caveats, e.g. availability outside mainland China.
